title: Publication-grade audit of DS17 stable basins
statement: Independent adversarial audit of the DS17 centered obstruction, LCM merged-branch classification, necessary fixed-point gate, measured gate scans, and the resulting compile/open-problem reroutes. All four DS17 nodes are hardened: the obstruction and eventual empirical emptiness survive; root consistency is separated from regular tilt consistency at a singular nuisance block; LCM and sign-split conclusions are narrowed; and finite scans are retained only as windowed measured evidence.

exact claims recomputed with fractions.Fraction; population controls use an independently derived adaptive quadrature path
the audit does not re-audit inherited DS-SCHUR, FI-QUANT-IDENTITY, FI-RANK-CEILING, or the measured dependency of the compile certificate
